knowledge_gaps: Reproduction details are incomplete: baseline checkpoint selection, calibration-pair sampling and weighting, numerical safeguards, causal prefix pooling, and exported predictor parity are unspecified. Difficulty 2 understates integration work until these details are resolved.

The standard-deviation ratio can become unstable when cosine margins have little variance. It does not establish that training-pair calibration transfers to validation candidates or full-catalog recommendations. The residual score is candidate-dependent; only its history representation and calibration are candidate-independent.

Selecting among seven configurations on 200 validation users per category creates selection optimism. Baseline tie-breaking alone does not address this, and uncertainty measured after selection must acknowledge the search.

Recent-item similarity may reinforce the diagnosed redundancy problem. The proposal needs controls that distinguish useful recency from general embedding similarity and popularity. Originality 3 is reasonable; potential 7 remains speculative without results.

follow_up_queries.reason: Assess whether margin-based calibration is justified and identify safeguards needed for stable, reproducible additive scoring.
follow_up_queries.query: For recommendation ensembles combining frozen SASRec dot-product scores with recent-history item-embedding cosine similarity, what evidence supports calibrating the residual by training positive-negative margin standard-deviation ratios? Compare robust scale estimates, near-zero denominator safeguards, correlated scores, and transfer from training negatives to sampled validation and full-catalog ranking.

follow_up_queries.reason: Determine how to report exploratory gains without treating the winning validation configuration as independent confirmation.
follow_up_queries.query: What methods address validation-selection optimism when comparing a baseline and six recommender configurations on fixed sampled candidates, with 200 users in each of four datasets and macro-average HR@10? Discuss paired category-stratified bootstrap limitations after selection and training-only chronological tuning without accessing held-out test labels.

follow_up_queries.reason: Find inexpensive controls and implementation conventions that distinguish recency benefits from similarity shortcuts while preserving causal inference behavior.
follow_up_queries.query: In SASRec augmented with a frozen recent-history cosine residual, which ablations distinguish useful recency from item popularity and general history similarity? Examine last-item versus recent-K versus full-history pooling, causal prefix alignment under left padding, repeated interactions, and numerical equivalence between diagnostic scoring and exported inference.
